subject: Request: Pilot bridge credits + temporary discount for BlueNova POC
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@bluenova.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@bluenova.io
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — ask for bridge credits and short-term pricing

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We pushed a small but painful infra change yesterday that set our integration back ~10 days — engineering ran into an unexpected protobuf mismatch when streaming telemetry to your ingestion endpoint. We attached the relevant logs for context.

Given the delay and the fact that we still want to validate the end-to-end latency story with a larger token mix, can Redwood provide: 1) a one-time pilot credit top-up (50k tokens equivalent) to cover the extended POC window, and 2) a short-term 20% price discount for the first two weeks after we flip to production while we run internal load tests?

Both items are do-or-die for us right now — the extended runway buys the exec team more confidence. If there are internal approvals required, happy to sign a brief addendum or DocuSign.

Appreciate any help you can do here.

— Samir
Samir Khan | Head of ML Engineering | BlueNova Systems
Attachment: bluenova_integration_logs.zip (text, 84 KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@bluenova.io>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — ask for bridge credits and short-term pricing

Samir — thanks for the context and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear about the protobuf snag; team-level delays are never fun.

I can provision a one-time credit top-up to cover the extended POC. For the temporary price discount you requested, that needs a quick sign-off from our commercial lead and manager (copying them). To speed things up, I put together a proposed package below:

- One-time credit top-up: 50,000 token-equivalent credits (applied to the existing pilot project).
- Short-term discount: 15% off list for 14 days post-production flip (we can make 20% possible but will need exec approval — noted).
- Contingency: If production flip happens >30 days from now, discount window can be extended by mutual agreement.

I'll loop in Aditya and Naomi with a quick note to request an exception approval and include a short cost impact and DocuSign addendum draft. If leadership can sign off today, I will send the formal offer and walk you through the DocuSign flow.

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: BlueNova — credit top-up + short-term discount (exec approval requested)

Aditya / Naomi — forwarding BlueNova ask. Quick summary and proposed ask:

Context: BlueNova (early-stage ML infra startup) hit an integration delay; they want a) 50k token-equivalent pilot top-up and b) a short 20% discount for 14 days after production flip. Customer willing to sign an addendum.

Why it matters: BlueNova is on track to convert to a committed seat within 60 days if the latency numbers hold after broader load testing — this is a time-sensitive runway ask.

Commercial proposal (my recommendation):
- Approve: 50k pilot credit top-up (no change to MRR).
- Approve: temporary 15% discount for 14 days post-prod flip (we can escalate to 20% if exec wants to trade for a three-month minimum commitment).

Cost/impact: estimated revenue deferral of ~$2.7k (at list rates) and net marginal uplift on conversion probability. I attached a one-page proposed committed offer that canonicalizes the discount window and the DocuSign link.

Attachments: proposed_committed_offer_v1.pdf (PDF, 28 KB)

Can you please advise approval or escalation path? If you both OK, I will send the DocuSign and the credit allocation.

Thanks — Monica

Subject: Re: Fwd: BlueNova — credit top-up + short-term discount (exec approval requested)

Monica / Naomi — thanks for the clear summary. I support granting the credit top-up (50k). For the temporary discount, I'm comfortable with 15% for 14 days straight away.

If Monica wants to offer 20% we should ask for a clear return: either a 3-month minimal commit or a signed pilot-to-paid conversion milestone with a target ARR. Without a commitment, 20% feels like an open-ended concession.

Naomi — can you sign/ok the 15% / 50k from a managerial budget perspective? If you want this to hit exec for 20% we should escalate to Marcus or Marissa.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao | Head of Sales, US | Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BlueNova — credit top-up + short-term discount (exec approval requested)

Aditya / Monica — I approve the 50k pilot credit top-up and the 15% / 14-day discount as an exception from the strategic accounts discretionary pool. Please include the following in the DocuSign addendum:
1) Discount window defined as 14 calendar days from the date BlueNova executes the addendum AND flips production traffic.
2) A commitment clause: If BlueNova does not convert to a paid plan within 60 days of flip, any additional credits will be paused (we retain the right to rescind future concessions).
3) Limit the total uplift of credits issued to this account under trial exceptions to 75k tokens for Q2-Q3 2027 (so this 50k fits under the cap).

Monica — you have my OK to proceed with DocuSign and to apply the credit once the addendum is executed. Please copy legal if they tweak contract language.

-Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
